## Core Specializations & Services

### 1. Brand Identity Systems
- URL: https://madebykhizar.com/services.html#brand-identity
- Deliverables: Primary logo suite, secondary lockups, wordmarks, color palettes (CMYK, Pantone, RGB), typography hierarchies, and vector master assets (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF, PNG).
- Ideal For: Consumer-brand founders, DTC businesses, and startups requiring scalable visual foundations.

### 2. Packaging & Label Design
- URL: https://madebykhizar.com/services.html#packaging-design
- Deliverables: Structural dieline setup, SKU range extensions, multi-variant architecture, label typography, material & finish specifications (embossing, foil stamping, spot UV, matte/gloss varnishes), and printer-ready production artwork.
- Ideal For: FMCG food products, beverages, cosmetics, dietary supplements, and retail goods requiring instant shelf standout.

### 3. Brand Guidelines & Systems
- URL: https://madebykhizar.com/services.html#brand-guidelines
- Deliverables: Authoritative brand manuals, clear-space formulas, minimum scale thresholds, color contrast formulas, digital/print dos and don'ts, and packaged asset libraries for internal team handoff.
- Ideal For: Growing product businesses scaling across multiple designers, vendors, and regional marketing teams.

### 4. Commercial Collateral & Motion
- URL: https://madebykhizar.com/services.html#commercial-collateral
- Deliverables: Product launch marketing collateral, retail sales sheets, digital presentation templates, and animated logo stings/motion reveals.
- Ideal For: Product launches, retail distribution pitches, and social promotional campaigns.

## 5-Step Brand Framework
1. Discover: Audit the product category, competitor landscape, and consumer expectations.
2. Define: Establish positioning, creative direction, and visual principles before designing.
3. Design: Craft the logo suite, typography hierarchy, and core visual identity system.
4. Apply: Translate the identity into shelf-ready packaging dielines, digital interfaces, and physical touchpoints.
5. Deliver: Provide organized, production-ready vector packages, print files, and comprehensive guidelines.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Summary)
- Project Timelines: Brand identity systems take 2–3 weeks. Packaging and full brand guideline projects take 3–5 weeks depending on SKU count.
- Print Preparation: All packaging artwork is engineered to exact printer dielines, specifying Pantone formulas, bleed margins, barcode specifications, and special finishes.
- International Remote Collaboration: Over 80% of projects are conducted remotely with clients in the US, UK, and Middle East via structured async communication, video calls, and organized digital handoffs.
- Inquiries: Direct via https://madebykhizar.com/#contact or WhatsApp at https://wa.link/kg29k3.
